description:
You are debugging a sensitive batch processing application. Your goal is to find the value of the local variable 'currentProcessValue' inside the 'processData' method during the 888th iteration of the loop (when i == 888). 

1. Open the 'DataBatchAnalyzer' project.
2. Open 'src/main/java/com/example/Main.java'.
3. Set a CONDITIONAL BREAKPOINT inside the loop to pause execution ONLY when i == 888.
4. Run the application in DEBUG mode.
5. Inspect the variable 'currentProcessValue' when the breakpoint hits.
6. Create a file named 'solution.txt' in the home directory (/home/ga/solution.txt) and paste the exact numeric value into it.

WARNING: The source code is READ-ONLY. Do not modify the source code (e.g., do not add print statements), or you will fail the task.
